newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND CAPTAIN OUT OF PUMAS TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND CAPTAIN OUT OF PUMAS TEST.

text.p: England captain Phil de Glanville has been ruled out of Saturday's rugby union test against Argentina at Twickenham with a leg strain.
Prop Jason Leonard will take over the captaincy for the first time, with Jeremy Guscott moving in from the wing to his normal position at centre.
The reshuffle also gives winger Tony Underwood the chance to resume his international career on the wing after 18 months on the sidelines.
Fly-half Mike Catt is also doubtful with a chest problem.
